evals.prompt: Four folders each contain layer1 to layer100; they are four independent volumes. Align with SOFIMA and save lossless TIFF plus XY-only precomputed at 5,5,100 nm.
evals.expected_output: Four separate manifests/runs; native pilot; preserve inputs and origins; separate TIFF/precomputed deliverables; Z=100 at every level; no fabricated completion.

evals.prompt: Use Popovych's Princeton Nature Communications method. I have no checkpoint yet.
evals.expected_output: Identify metroEM/corgie, SEAMLeSS and ABCD with correct DOI; audit and needs_configuration; require compatible model/hash/scale; no surrogate presented as reproduction.

evals.prompt: Use FEABAS; my mask has white tissue and black background.
evals.expected_output: Explain polarity mismatch, preserve original and prepare explicit derived material-mask conversion; validate component geometry and native loader.

evals.prompt: The accepted aligned data already exist in CloudVolume. I only need TIFF under the specified output directory.
evals.expected_output: Read mip0 metadata and ordered IDs, export original dtype and physical metadata with full readback; no realignment.

evals.prompt: Use FEABAS tensorstore_downsample defaults, but only downsample XY and keep everything lossless.
evals.expected_output: Identify auto Z and JPEG defaults as incompatible; configure verified native alternative or use common exporter; preserve Z count, offset and spacing.

evals.prompt: Compare all three methods and prove the highest NCC is the most accurate, although there is no ground truth.
evals.expected_output: Same physical pilot/common valid support; NCC as continuity proxy only; morphology/landmarks/deformation/failure evidence; no unsupported accuracy ranking.

evals.prompt: Rerun with a different mesh parameter using the existing checkpoints.
evals.expected_output: Changed config/run identity detected; preserve old outputs, use new run or deliberate stage invalidation; no stale-cache success.
